name: DST INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship
funder: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India
amount: Rs 1,25,000/month consolidated (Rs 2,000 annual increment) + Rs 7 lakh/year research grant
other_rules: Indian citizens and Persons of Indian Origin
age 32 or under on 1 January of the call year (37 for SC/ST/women, 42 for benchmark disability)
at least 60% marks from Class 12 onwards
no permanent academic or research position
contractual staff in India must resign on selection
notes: 2025 call ran 15 Aug to 14 Sep 2025; a 2026 call was not found. Open to applicants abroad who are Indian citizens or PIO. Fellows can later apply for the SERB Research Scientist scheme. Details from a Biotecnika summary of the 2025 call.
